title: Debug and fix book display issue preventing catalog from rendering

requirements.text: Add comprehensive console logging to BookCatalog component to debug why books are not displaying, including logging the raw catalog data from useGetBookCatalog, the filtered books array, the coverImages mapping object, and any errors during rendering

quotes: Still can't see the books. Tell me a solution. What should I do? The books should be displayed on the web page.

acceptanceCriteria: Console logs show the catalog data being fetched from the backend
Console logs reveal whether the books array is empty or populated
Console logs show the coverImages mapping and whether image paths are correctly resolved
Any runtime errors or missing data are logged to help identify the root cause

requirements.text: Verify that the backend getBookCatalog query is returning all 12 books (4 Thriller, 4 Romantic, 4 Ghost) with correct titles, authors, genres, and prices, and add backend logging if necessary to confirm data is being served
acceptanceCriteria: Each book has title, author, genre, and price fields populated
Books include all genres: Thriller, Romantic, and Ghost

requirements.text: Check and fix the coverImages mapping in BookCatalog component to ensure all 12 book titles exactly match the keys in the mapping object, accounting for any case sensitivity or whitespace issues, and verify that all image paths point to existing files in frontend/public/assets/generated/

quotes: The books should be displayed on the web page.

acceptanceCriteria: All 12 book titles from the backend catalog have matching keys in coverImages object
Image paths correctly reference files like '/assets/generated/thriller-never-lie.dim_400x600.png'
No mismatches between book titles and image mapping keys

requirements.text: Add error boundary or fallback UI to BookCatalog component that displays a helpful error message if books fail to load, showing the user what went wrong and providing troubleshooting information

quotes: Tell me a solution. What should I do?

acceptanceCriteria: If catalog fetch fails, a clear error message is displayed to the user
If books array is empty, a message indicates no books are available
Error UI helps identify whether the issue is with backend, frontend, or data mapping

requirements.text: Ensure SampleBooks component is correctly using the useGetBookCatalog hook and rendering all 12 books without any filters or limitations, mapping book titles to cover images and displaying them in a grid layout

quotes: I still can't see the books.

acceptanceCriteria: SampleBooks component renders all 12 books from the catalog
Each book displays with cover image, title, author, and price
Grid layout shows all books simultaneously without pagination or filtering

constraints: Do not modify the backend/main.mo actor structure beyond necessary logging additions
Do not change the existing book catalog data (12 books with specified titles, authors, genres, and prices)
Preserve the existing cover image filenames in frontend/public/assets/generated/
nonGoals: Redesigning the book catalog UI layout
Adding new books to the catalog
Implementing genre filtering (already removed per previous requirements)
